Work in /opt/nxeon (Next.js/TS, LIVE prod tree). Make the customer-portal deploy/checkout wizards DISPLAY prices in the visitor's selected display currency, while the actual CHARGE stays in USD. This is money-sensitive — read carefully.

## The problem
The currency switcher (portal header) localizes marketing pages, but the portal deploy wizards still show hardcoded USD (e.g. `components/customer/DeployWizard.tsx` has `const money = (c) => \`$${(c/100).toFixed(2)}\``). Selecting CHF/VND/etc. doesn't change them.

## Files you OWN (find them all)
The VPS deploy wizard `components/customer/DeployWizard.tsx`, plus the shared-hosting and game deploy/checkout wizards (search components/customer for `DeployWizard`, `HostingDeployWizard`, `GameDeployWizard`, and any order/review/checkout component they render that shows a price/total). Do NOT touch: `lib/currency*`, `lib/tax.ts`, `components/currency/*`, `lib/order.ts`, or any server action / quote / checkout server logic.

## Exactly what to do
1. In each wizard (they are client components rendered inside the dashboard layout's `CurrencyProvider`, so hooks work): use the existing display-currency hooks — `import { useCurrency } from "@/components/currency/CurrencyContext"` and/or `useDisplayMoney` — the SAME pattern the migrated marketing components use (look at `components/marketing/PricingGrid.tsx` or `VpsConfigurator.tsx` for the exact hook usage and the `convertAndFormat`/rate approach). Replace the local `money()` formatter so the STRING shown to the user is converted to the selected currency (`useCurrency()` gives `{ currency, rate }` or use `useDisplayMoney()` which returns a formatter). Cover every displayed price: plan cards, term selector, add-ons, and the Review/total.

2. **CRITICAL — do NOT convert any value that flows into a charge/order.** The amount sent to the order/quote/checkout server action MUST remain the USD integer cents it is today. Only the DISPLAYED string changes. Concretely: keep the existing `priceCents` (USD) math untouched for anything passed to a server action, `placeOrder`, quote, or `orderVps`-type call; only wrap the user-visible formatting in the converting formatter. If you're unsure whether a number is display-only or charge-bound, leave the charge path alone.

3. **Add an honest billing note.** Wherever a total/price is shown converted AND at the Review/checkout step, add a clear, visible line: e.g. "Prices shown in {CURRENCY} for reference — you're billed in USD (${usd amount})." Only show this note when the selected display currency ≠ USD. This keeps it truthful that Stripe charges USD. Keep it concise and on-brand (muted helper text near the total).

## Constraints
- Do NOT run `npm run build`/`next build` — `npx tsc --noEmit` only.
- Match the existing hook/formatting pattern exactly (don't invent a new currency mechanism).
- Everything must degrade to identical current behavior when the display currency is USD (byte-for-byte, so USD users see no change).

## Report
(a) Each wizard file changed + how (which prices now convert). (b) Proof you did NOT alter any charge-bound amount — name the charge/order call in each wizard and confirm it still receives USD cents. (c) The exact "billed in USD" note wording + where it appears. (d) `npx tsc --noEmit` result.

const { currency, rate } = useCurrency();
